## LOAD PACKAGES

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(flextable)
library(purrr)
library(here)
library(UpSetR)

```

## LOAD FILES

```{r, warning=FALSE}

#Rename model result dfs * convert estimates to percents for reporting
#M1: Core
load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_childrural_core.rda")
core_rural <- results_rural_cannotated
rm(results_rural_cannotated)
core_rural <- core_rural %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_schlyrs_core.rda")
core_schlyrs <- results_schlyrs_cannotated
rm(results_schlyrs_cannotated)
core_schlyrs <- core_schlyrs %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_livegpar_core.rda")
core_livegpar <- results_livegpar_cannotated
rm(results_livegpar_cannotated)
core_livegpar <- core_livegpar %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_chsmk_core.rda")
core_chsmk <- results_chsmk_cannotated
rm(results_chsmk_cannotated)
core_chsmk <- core_chsmk %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

#M2: Health Only
load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_childrural_hm.rda")
h_rural <- results_rural_hannotated
rm(results_rural_hannotated)
h_rural <- h_rural %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_schlyrs_h.rda")
h_schlyrs <- results_schlyrs_hannotated
rm(results_schlyrs_hannotated)
h_schlyrs <- h_schlyrs %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_livegpar_h.rda")
h_livegpar <- results_livegpar_hannotated
rm(results_livegpar_hannotated)
h_livegpar <- h_livegpar %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm1_chsmk_h.rda")
h_chsmk <- results_chsmk_hannotated
rm(results_chsmk_hannotated)
h_chsmk <- h_chsmk %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

#M3: Health, socioeconomic, and behavior Variables
load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm3_rural_ds8.rda")
rural_smk_8 <- results_rural_ds8annotated
rm(results_rural_ds8annotated)
rural_m3 <- rural_smk_8 %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm3_schlyrs_ds9.rda")

rm(results_schlyrs_ds9annotated)
schlyrs_m3 <- schlyrs_m3 %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm3_livegpar_ds10.rda")

rm(results_livegpar_ds10annotated)
livegpar_m3 <- livegpar_smk_10 %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)

load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm3_chsmk_ds.rda")
chsmk_ds <- results_chsmk_dsannotated
rm(results_chsmk_dsannotated)
chsmk_m3 <- chsmk_ds %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)


#Mutually Adjusted Exposure Models
load("NewData/EWAS/resultsm3_allexposures_2026May07.rda")
all_exposures <- results_allexpannotated
rm(results_allexpannotated)
all_exposures <- all_exposures %>% mutate(logFCpercent = logFC * 100)


rm(rural_smk_8, livegpar_smk_10, chsmk_ds)

#Maternal educational attainment in pregnancy and epigenome-wide DNA methylation changes in the offspring from birth until adolescence (PMID: 38052982)
maternal_educ_ewas <- readxl::read_xlsx("Datasets/PMID-38052982-ewas-maternaleducation.xlsx")

#Epigenetic signatures of cigarette smoking (PMID: 27651444)
  ## Current vs Never Smokers
currentsmk_ewas <-  readxl::read_xlsx("Datasets/PMC5267325_meta-ewas_currentcigarettesmoking.xlsx")

#Epigenetic signatures of cigarette smoking (PMID: 27651444)
  ## Former vs Never Smokers
formersmk_ewas <-  readxl::read_xlsx("Datasets/PMC5267325_meta-ewas_formercigarettesmoking.xlsx")

```


## UPSET PLOTS (P<0.0001) 
### HEALTH SES BEHAVIOR MODEL (Supplemental Figure 5)
```{r}

### Health, Socioeconomic Status, and Behavior EWAS 
### P<0.0001 level
png(here("Manuscript/upsetplot_healthSESbehav_plessthan0.0001.png"), width=7, height=5, units='in', res=300)

upset(fromList(
  list("Grew up in a rural area" = rural_m3$CpG[rural_m3$P.Value < 0.0001],
        "Years in school" = schlyrs_m3$CpG[schlyrs_m3$P.Value < 0.0001],
        "Live with a grandparent" = livegpar_m3$CpG[livegpar_m3$P.Value < 0.0001],
        "Smoking during childhood" = chsmk_m3$CpG[chsmk_m3$P.Value < 0.0001])
    ), nsets=4)

dev.off()

```

### MUTUALLY ADJUSTED EXPOSURES (Supplemental Figure 7)
```{r}
png(here("Manuscript/upsetplot_mutually-adjusted-exposures_plessthan0.0001.png"), width=7, height=5, units='in', res=300)

listp <- all_exposures %>% dplyr::filter(P.Value < 0.0001) %>% 
                              dplyr::group_by(exposure) %>% 
                              dplyr::summarise(CpGs = list(unique(CpG)), .groups = "drop") %>% tibble::deframe()

names(listp)
names(listp) <- c("Grew up in a rural area", "Smoking during childhood", "Live with a grandparent", "Years in school")

UpSetR::upset(fromList(listp),
              sets = names(listp),
              nsets = 4,
              order.by = "freq")

dev.off()
```


## SCATTER PLOTS (Supplemental Figure 8)

### COMPARE MODEL COEFFICENTS BETWEEN EXPOSURES (M3/Primary)

```{r, warning=FALSE}

png("Manuscript/Compare_Models/Mar21_exposure-by-exposure-betas-scatter_allp.png", width=2800, height=1750, res = 300)

par(mfrow=c(2, 3), mar=c(5,5,2,2))

#rural x schlyrs
both.results <- rural_m3 %>%
  inner_join(schlyrs_m3, by="CpG", suffix=c(".rural_m3", ".schlyrs_m3")) %>%
  select(CpG, beta.rural_m3 = logFC.rural_m3, p.rural_m3 = P.Value.rural_m3, 
         beta.schlyrs_m3 = logFC.schlyrs_m3, p.schlyrs_m3 = P.Value.schlyrs_m3)
# All CpGs
smoothScatter(both.results$beta.rural_m3 ~ both.results$beta.schlyrs_m3, 
              xlab="Years in school", ylab="Grew up in a rural area", cex.lab=1.8, cex.axis=1.1)
cor_r <- cor(both.results$beta.rural_m3, both.results$beta.schlyrs_m3)
mtext(paste("r = ", round(cor_r, 2)), side=3, line=-1.8, adj=0.05, cex=1.3)

  inner_join(livegpar_m3, by="CpG", suffix=c(".rural_m3", ".livegpar_m3")) %>%
```

## COMPARE SITES WITHIN OUR STUDY

```{r}

#CHILD RURAL OVERLAP
overlap_rural <- Reduce(intersect, list(rural_m3$CpG, core_rural$CpG, h_rural$CpG))

overlap_rural <- data.frame(
  CpG = overlap_rural,
  chr = rural_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(CHR),
  pos = rural_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(BP),
  gene = rural_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(UCSC_RefGene_Name),
  rural_m3.estimate = rural_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(logFC),
  rural_m3.pval = rural_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(P.Value),
  core_rural.estimate = core_rural %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(logFC),
  core_rural.pval = core_rural %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(P.Value),
  h_rural.estimate = h_rural %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(logFC),
  h_rural.pval = h_rural %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_rural) %>% pull(P.Value)
)

overlap_rural$gene <- gsub(";.*", "", overlap_rural$gene)
write_xlsx(overlap_rural, "Manuscript/Compare_Models/ALL Child Rural Models CpG Overlap.xlsx", format_headers = TRUE)


#SCHLYRS OVERLAP

  core_schlyrs.pval = core_schlyrs %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs) %>% pull(P.Value),

)
```

## COMPARE SITES WITH PRIOR LITERATURE

### Years in School

```{r}
#SCHLYRS OVERLAP
overlap_schlyrs_maternalea <- Reduce(intersect, list(maternal_educ_ewas$CpG, schlyrs_m3$CpG))
overlap_schlyrs2 <- data.frame(
  CpG = overlap_schlyrs_maternalea,
  chr = schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(CHR),
  pos = schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(BP),
  gene = schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(UCSC_RefGene_Name),
  schlyrs_m3.estimate = schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(logFC),
  schlyrs_m3.pval = schlyrs_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(P.Value),
  maternal_educ_ewas.estimate = maternal_educ_ewas %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(logFC),
  maternal_educ_ewas.pval = maternal_educ_ewas %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_schlyrs_maternalea) %>% pull(P.Value)
)
overlap_schlyrs2$gene <- gsub(";.*", "", overlap_schlyrs2$gene)

# Get top shared significant site (p< 0.0001)
sig_hitss2 <- overlap_schlyrs2 %>%  filter(maternal_educ_ewas.pval < 0.0001 & schlyrs_m3.pval < 0.0001)

sheets = list('All Overlap' = overlap_schlyrs2, 'P<0.0001' = sig_hitss2)
writexl::write_xlsx(sheets, 'Manuscript/Compare_Models/M3 Years in School Overlap p<0.0001 maternal ea.xlsx', format_headers = TRUE)

```

```{r}
  CpG = overlap_chsmk_currentsmk,
  chr = chsmk_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk_currentsmk) %>% pull(CHR),
  pos = chsmk_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk_currentsmk) %>% pull(BP),
  gene = chsmk_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk_currentsmk) %>% pull(UCSC_RefGene_Name),
  chsmk_m3.estimate = chsmk_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk_currentsmk) %>% pull(logFC),
  chsmk_m3.pval = chsmk_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk_currentsmk) %>% pull(P.Value),
  currentsmk_ewas.estimate = currentsmk_ewas %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk_currentsmk) %>% pull(logFC),
  currentsmk_ewas.pval = currentsmk_ewas %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk_currentsmk) %>% pull(P.Value)
)
overlap_chsmk3$gene <- gsub(";.*", "", overlap_chsmk3$gene)

# Get top shared significant site (p< 0.0001)
sig_hitsc3 <- overlap_chsmk3 %>%  filter(currentsmk_ewas.pval < 0.0001 & chsmk_m3.pval < 0.0001)

sheets = list('All Overlap' = overlap_chsmk3, 'P<0.0001' = sig_hitsc3)
writexl::write_xlsx(sheets, 'Manuscript/Compare_Models/M3 Child Smoking Overlap p<0.0001 currentsmk.xlsx', format_headers = TRUE)


overlap_chsmk_formersmk <- Reduce(intersect, list(formersmk_ewas$CpG, chsmk_m3$CpG))
overlap_chsmk4 <- data.frame(
  CpG = overlap_chsmk_formersmk,
  chr = chsmk_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk_formersmk) %>% pull(CHR),
  pos = chsmk_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk_formersmk) %>% pull(BP),
  gene = chsmk_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk_formersmk) %>% pull(UCSC_RefGene_Name),
  chsmk_m3.estimate = chsmk_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk_formersmk) %>% pull(logFC),
  chsmk_m3.pval = chsmk_m3 %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk_formersmk) %>% pull(P.Value),
  formersmk_ewas.estimate = formersmk_ewas %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk_formersmk) %>% pull(logFC),
  formersmk_ewas.pval = formersmk_ewas %>% filter(CpG %in% overlap_chsmk_formersmk) %>% pull(P.Value)
)
overlap_chsmk4$gene <- gsub(";.*", "", overlap_chsmk4$gene)

# Get top shared significant site (p< 0.0001)
sig_hitsc4 <- overlap_chsmk4 %>%  filter(formersmk_ewas.pval < 0.0001 & chsmk_m3.pval < 0.0001)

sheets = list('All Overlap' = overlap_chsmk4, 'P<0.0001' = sig_hitsc4)
writexl::write_xlsx(sheets, 'Manuscript/Compare_Models/M3 Child Smoking Overlap p<0.0001 formersmk.xlsx', format_headers = TRUE)

```
